action: Protect the relationship: tiered savings and FD ladders, and a retention offer before large deposits mature.
Card rewards and instalment plans; they keep little in savings, so lend with care.
Win the salary: salary-crediting incentives, and the best audience for personal financing.
Get the card into use: in-app activation nudges and first-purchase cashback.
Low-cost re-engagement: bill reminders and DuitNow QR prompts.
Win back only where it is cheap; stop paying bonuses to channels that produce them.
